title: Switch Transformers: Scaling to Trillion Parameter Models
authors: W. Fedus, B. Zoph, N. Shazeer
before: Mixture-of-experts routing sent each token to several experts, with fiddly balancing losses.
problem: Multi-expert routing was complex, unstable and communication-heavy.
breakthrough: Route each token to exactly one expert. Simpler, faster, and stable to a trillion parameters.
why: It made sparse scaling simple enough to copy, which is why MoE is now standard at the frontier.
next: Mixtral, DeepSeekMoE, Llama 4 and Kimi all descend from this simplification.
inherits: Top-1 style routing and the parameter-count-versus-active-parameters distinction.
